title: SoK: Are LLMs Reliable at Source Code Recovery? A Taxonomy and Empirical Evaluation
title_zh: 知识体系：大型语言模型在源代码恢复方面是否可靠？——分类与实证评估

paragraphs.en: Effective source recovery is critical to security applications such as malware analysis, vulnerability assessment, and legacy maintenance. Large Language Models (LLMs) are reshaping this field, shifting the paradigm away from rule-based heuristics to probabilistic and high fidelity semantic recovery of source code from assembly or classical decompiler-derived pseudo-C. However, despite rapid progress, the field suffers from fragmentation across numerous approaches as well as their non-unified evaluations, limiting objective comparisons. Further, existing works have limited coverage of embedded, IoT architectures and source languages beyond C/C++. In this work, we present the first Systematization of Knowledge (SoK) focused specifically on LLM-assisted binary-to-source recovery. We provide a granular design-centric taxonomy of LLM-assisted source recovery methods and systematic evaluations using seven key metrics along six evaluation dimensions. We evaluate state-of-the-art methods on 45,000 test samples derived from four standard and five embedded architectures, five optimization levels, and symbol stripping. We ablate the impact of design choices on recovery performance, including input representation, contextual enrichment, model scale, iteration and review roles using controlled in-house recovery pipelines and three off-the-shelf models. Finally, we test same-language and cross-language recovery capability covering four mature and two legacy languages. Our systematization and comprehensive evaluations provide key insights that guide future directions in this field.
paragraphs.zh: 有效的源代码恢复对于安全应用（如恶意软件分析、漏洞评估和遗留系统维护）至关重要。 大型语言模型（LLM）正在重塑这一领域，将范式从基于规则的启发式方法转向概率性且高保真的语义恢复，即从汇编代码或传统反编译器生成的伪C代码中恢复源代码。 然而，尽管取得了快速进展，该领域仍存在诸多方法的碎片化问题，以及这些方法缺乏统一的评估标准，从而限制了客观比较的可能性。 此外，现有研究对嵌入式、物联网架构以及超出C/C++范围的源代码语言的覆盖有限。 在本项工作中，我们首次提出专门针对LLM辅助的二进制到源代码恢复的系统化知识综述（SoK）。 我们提供了一套以设计为中心的LLM辅助源代码恢复方法的精细分类体系，并基于六个评估维度和七个关键指标进行了系统性评估。 我们在45,000个测试样本上评估了当前最先进的多种方法，这些样本源自四种标准架构和五种嵌入式架构、五种优化级别以及符号剥离处理。 我们通过受控的内部恢复流程以及三种现成模型，分析了设计选择对恢复性能的影响，包括输入表示、上下文增强、模型规模、迭代过程及审查角色等。 最后，我们测试了同语言与跨语言的恢复能力，覆盖四种成熟语言和两种遗留语言。 我们的系统化综述和全面评估为未来该领域的发展方向提供了关键见解。

paragraphs.en: Source code recovery is a critical building block of reverse engineering, computer security, and software maintenance. It enables security analysts to inspect and investigate programs [ 69 ] , analyze malware [ 24 ] , audit third-party binaries for vulnerabilities [ 57 ] , plagiarism detection [ 74 ] , and so on, all without access to original source code. Traditional decompilers such as Hex-Rays [ 36 ] , Binary Ninja [ 10 ] , Ghidra [ 32 ] , and Angr [ 58 ] typically operate on a pipeline of deterministic Intermediate Representations (IR), control flow reconstruction algorithms, pattern matching and type inference heuristics. While these classical tools preserve lower-level control execution semantics, their output is marred by issues like poor readability, unnatural control constructs, lost variable names, and fragmented type structures, which ultimately hinders human analysis and recompilation [ 22 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 源代码恢复是逆向工程、计算机安全和软件维护的关键组成部分。 它使安全分析师能够在没有原始源代码的情况下检查和研究程序 [ 69 ]，分析恶意软件 [ 24 ]，审计第三方二进制文件以发现漏洞 [ 57 ]，进行抄袭检测 [ 74 ] 等等。 传统的反编译器，如 Hex-Rays [ 36 ]、Binary Ninja [ 10 ]、Ghidra [ 32 ] 和 Angr [ 58 ]，通常在由确定性中间表示（IR）、控制流重建算法、模式匹配和类型推断启发式方法组成的流水线上运行。 尽管这些经典工具保留了低层控制执行的语义，但其输出却存在可读性差、控制结构不自然、变量名丢失和类型结构碎片化等问题，最终阻碍了人工分析和重新编译 [ 22 ]。

paragraphs.en: The emergence of Large Language Models (LLMs) trained on massive language and code corpora has led to unprecedented capabilities in code generation, analysis, and software comprehension. Building upon this proficiency, LLMs are now increasingly being used to address the challenges in reverse engineering [ 56 , 73 , 40 ] . Rather than relying purely on deterministic rules, LLM-assisted source recovery models treat decompilation or pseudo-C refinement as a neural sequence-to-sequence translation task that converts low-level representations to recompilable and equivalent high-level source code. These approaches show promise in recovering idiomatic function names, expressive variable and type structures, and clean high-level abstractions directly from assembly or decompiled pseudo-C output [ 73 , 72 , 65 , 55 , 70 , 41 , 66 ] . Despite rapid proliferation across top security, software engineering, and AI venues, the research landscape remains highly fragmented. Even when restricting the scope to top-tier venues (see Section III-B ) over the past two years, 13 distinct methodologies have been published [ 38 , 65 , 29 , 71 , 63 , 41 , 46 , 13 , 79 , 23 , 2 , 64 , 62 ] , alongside several pre-prints this year [ 78 , 18 , 49 , 59 , 30 , 44 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 在海量语言和代码语料库上训练的大型语言模型（LLM）的出现，使代码生成、分析和软件理解方面实现了前所未有的能力。 基于这种卓越能力，LLM 正越来越多地被用于解决逆向工程中的挑战 [ 56 , 73 , 40 ] 。 LLM 辅助的源代码恢复模型不再完全依赖确定性规则，而是将反编译或伪 C 语言精修视为一种神经序列到序列翻译任务，将低层表示转换为可重新编译且等效的高层源代码。 这些方法在从汇编语言或反编译后的伪 C 语言输出中直接恢复惯用函数名、富有表现力的变量和类型结构以及清晰的高层抽象方面展现出良好前景 [ 73 , 72 , 65 , 55 , 70 , 41 , 66 ] 。 尽管这类研究在顶级安全、软件工程和人工智能领域的会议与期刊中迅速普及，但整个研究格局仍然高度碎片化。 即使将范围限定在过去两年内的顶级会议与期刊（见第 III-B 节），也已发表了 13 种不同的方法 [ 38 , 65 , 29 , 71 , 63 , 41 , 46 , 13 , 79 , 23 , 2 , 64 , 62 ] ，此外今年还出现了数篇预印本 [ 78 , 18 , 49 , 59 , 30 , 44 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Prior systematizations broadly explore LLM applications in reverse engineering with coarse taxonomies of LLM-based source recovery [ 39 , 3 , 48 ] . To the best of our knowledge, there is no existing systematization of the granular design choices of LLM-assisted source recovery methods, and no controlled ablations of such choices to measure their impact on fidelity. Further, evaluation metrics are highly fragmented, with 53 53 unique metrics identified across 20+ research papers in top venues on LLM-assisted source recovery from 2024–2026. Moreover, existing evaluations and benchmarks on LLM-assisted source recovery focus almost exclusively on x86-64 and C/C++ target generation [ 31 , 66 , 77 ] , with coverage of non-C languages only by a few method papers and limited to C++ [ 71 , 46 ] , CUDA [ 63 ] , and Dart [ 1 ] . Further, decompilation fidelity across legacy and mature languages has only been studied for pre-LLM neural decompiations [ 37 ] . There is no existing evaluation of LLM-assisted source recovery that covers embedded systems architectures (armv7m, armv8m, armv7a, armv8a, and mips23le) [ 67 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 早期的系统化研究广泛探讨了 LLM 在逆向工程中的应用，但对基于 LLM 的源代码恢复方法仅进行了粗略的分类 [ 39 , 3 , 48 ] 。 据我们所知，目前尚无对 LLM 辅助源代码恢复方法的细粒度设计选择进行系统化的研究，也未对这些选择进行过受控的消融分析以衡量其对结果保真度的影响。 此外，评估指标高度碎片化：在 2024–2026 年间发表于顶级会议或期刊的 20 多篇关于 LLM 辅助源代码恢复的研究论文中，共识别出 53 个独特的评估指标。 而且，现有针对 LLM 辅助源代码恢复的评估和基准测试几乎完全集中在 x86-64 架构和 C/C++ 的目标代码生成上 [ 31 , 66 , 77 ] ，而非 C 语言的覆盖范围仅涉及少数方法论文，且仅限于 C++ [ 71 , 46 ] 、CUDA [ 63 ] 和 Dart [ 1 ] 。 此外，对于旧版语言和成熟语言的反编译保真度，目前的研究仅针对 LLM 出现前的神经网络反编译方法展开 [ 37 ] 。 目前尚无任何对 LLM 辅助源代码恢复的评估涵盖嵌入式系统架构（armv7m、armv8m、armv7a、armv8a 和 mips23le）[ 67 ] 。

paragraphs.en: RQ1: Evaluation Dimensions (Sections IV , V-A , VI-A ). As the Law of Leaky Abstraction (Joel Spolsky) states, “All non-trivial abstractions, to some extent, are leaky.” Two distinct source codes may have the same functional behavior through the reduction of noise to machine language during compilation. Thus, what dimensions must be considered to evaluate the fidelity of source recovery?
paragraphs.zh: 研究问题1：评估维度（第 IV、V-A、VI-A 节）。 正如“泄漏抽象定律”（Joel Spolsky）所述：“所有非平凡的抽象，在某种程度上都是会泄漏的。”两种不同的源代码可能通过编译过程中将噪声还原为机器语言而表现出相同的功能行为。 因此，评估源代码恢复的保真度需要考虑哪些维度？

paragraphs.en: To contextualize the shift from deterministic heuristics to neural source code recovery, this section outlines the fundamental mechanics of information loss during compilation and the differences between classical and neural decompilers.
paragraphs.zh: 为了将决定论启发式方法向神经源代码恢复的转型置于具体语境中，本节概述了编译过程中信息丢失的基本机制，以及经典反编译器与神经反编译器之间的差异。

paragraphs.en: Compilation is an inherently destructive, one-way transformation where a decompiler cannot recover the original source deterministically [ 21 ] . When high-level source code is translated into a machine-executable binary, the compiler strips away rich semantic abstractions such as meaningful variable names, custom data structures, class hierarchies, and idiomatic control flow constructs [ 17 , 43 , 54 , 45 ] . Furthermore, aggressive compiler optimizations can significantly refactor the underlying program logic to maximize hardware efficiency, through, for example, loop unrolling, function inlining, and dead code elimination [ 76 , 20 , 4 , 5 ] . Consequently, recovering the original source code is a challenging task, rooted in the many-to-one nature of the compilation process [ 50 , 25 , 11 ] . The practical goal of decompilation is therefore to recover a functionally equivalent and human-readable representation for a variety of use cases that include automated and manual analysis for vulnerability detection, patch diffing, malware analysis, program comprehension, and software license compliance [ 14 , 65 , 15 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 编译本质上是一种具有破坏性且单向的转换过程，反编译器无法确定性地恢复原始源代码 [ 21 ] 。 当高级源代码被转换为机器可执行的二进制文件时，编译器会剥离丰富的语义抽象层，例如有意义的变量名、自定义数据结构、类层次结构以及惯用的控制流结构 [ 17 , 43 , 54 , 45 ] 。 此外，激进的编译器优化可能会通过循环展开、函数内联和死代码消除等方式，对底层程序逻辑进行大幅重构，以最大化硬件效率 [ 76 , 20 , 4 , 5 ] 。 因此，恢复原始源代码是一项极具挑战性的任务，其根本原因在于编译过程的“多对一”特性 [ 50 , 25 , 11 ] 。 所以，反编译的实际目标是为多种使用场景恢复出功能等效且人类可读的表示形式，这些场景包括自动和手动分析以检测漏洞、补丁差异对比、恶意软件分析、程序理解以及软件许可证合规性检查 [ 14 , 65 , 15 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Traditional decompilers (e.g., Hex-Rays, Ghidra) address binary recovery through deterministic, iterative pipelines [ 81 ] . They typically disassemble raw machine code, lift the assembly instructions into an Intermediate Representation (IR), and perform extensive data-flow and control-flow graph (CFG) analyses [ 60 , 75 , 12 ] . Finally, heuristic-based structural analysis and type inference are applied to emit C-like pseudo-C. While mathematically sound and highly effective at preserving low-level execution semantics, these tools are brittle. Failure could occur when encountering heavily optimized code, non-standard calling conventions, or obfuscated binaries, often producing pseudo-C cluttered with unnatural goto statements and fragmented types that inhibit human comprehension [ 15 , 9 , 76 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 传统的反编译器（例如 Hex-Rays、Ghidra）通过确定性、迭代式的处理流程来实现二进制代码的恢复 [ 81 ] 。 它们通常先对原始机器码进行反汇编，将汇编指令提升为中间表示（IR），然后执行广泛的数据流分析和控制流图（CFG）分析 [ 60 , 75 , 12 ] 。 最后，通过基于启发式的结构分析和类型推断，生成类 C 的伪代码。 尽管这些工具在数学上是严谨的，且能高度有效地保留低层执行语义，但它们却十分脆弱。 当遇到高度优化的代码、非标准的调用约定或混淆过的二进制文件时，它们可能会失效，并常常生成充斥着不自然的 goto 语句和碎片化类型的伪代码，从而阻碍人类理解 [ 15 , 9 , 76 ] 。

paragraphs.en: The integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) frames source code recovery not as a problem of deterministic graph reduction, but as a neural translation task. By leveraging transformer architectures pre-trained on vast corpora of language, code, and assembly, neural decompilers attempt to probabilistically infer the lost semantic context. Instead of relying on hardcoded heuristics, these models ingest assembly language [ 41 , 65 , 29 ] , or pseudo-C [ 65 ] emitted by classical decompilers, and output high-level source code. Because they evaluate the global context of the input sequence, LLMs excel at generating idiomatic function names, reconstructing complex nested logic, and emitting highly readable code [ 56 ] . However, this probabilistic nature introduces a critical vulnerability: hallucinations. Neural models may generate syntactically flawless code that subtly alters the functional behavior of the original binary, creating a tension between readability and semantic or functional determinism [ 31 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）的整合将源代码恢复问题不再视为确定性图简化问题，而是将其视为一项神经翻译任务。 通过利用在海量语言、代码和汇编语料库上预训练的 Transformer 架构，神经反编译器试图以概率方式推断出丢失的语义上下文。 这些模型不再依赖硬编码的经验法则，而是输入由传统反编译器生成的汇编语言 [ 41 , 65 , 29 ] 或伪 C 语言 [ 65 ]，并输出高级源代码。 由于大型语言模型能够评估输入序列的全局上下文，因此它们在生成地道的函数名、重构复杂的嵌套逻辑以及输出高度可读的代码方面表现出色 [ 56 ]。 然而，这种概率性本质也引入了一个关键漏洞：幻觉。 神经模型可能会生成语法上完美无瑕但会微妙改变原始二进制文件功能行为的代码，从而在可读性与语义或功能确定性之间产生矛盾 [ 31 ]。

paragraphs.en: This section dives into the current literature on LLM-assisted source recovery and derive a five-axes taxonomy for this field. We gathered our literature corpus of research papers by querying DBLP over Jan 2020 to July 2026 with the keyword set (and variants) consisting of “decompilation” , “binary to source” , “assembly to source” , bytecode to source , “pseudocode to source” , “source code recovery” , and “recover* source code” . This search was restricted to A and A* CORE ranking 1 1 1 https://portal.core.edu.au/conf-ranks/ venues across three fields: Cybersecurity (S&P, USENIX Security, CCS, NDSS, EuroS&P, ASIACCS, CSF, ESORICS, RAID, ACSAC, DSN, TIFS, TDSC, WWW), Software Engineering (ICSE, FSE/ISSTA, ASE, SANER, ICSME, ISSRE, MSR, ICPC, ESEM, TSE, TOSEM, EMSE), and AI (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, AAAI, IJCAI, ACL, EMNLP, NAACL, COLING, EACL, COLM, AISTATS, UAI, TACL, JMLR, TMLR). We manually added two missing works, i.e., Nova [ 41 ] , due to the lack of relevant keywords in its title, and SK2Decompile [ 64 ] , due to recency of publication. This approach returned 57 57 candidate papers, of which 52 52 are relevant to decompilation consisting of 35 35 methods and 17 17 surveys or evaluations. Among the 35 35 method papers, 31 31 lie specifically in the scope of source-recovery, breaking down further into 19 19 LLM-assisted and 12 12 classical (non-LLM) works on source recovery. We focus only on the LLM-assisted methods, excluding six which target Virtual-Machine (VM) bytecode such as WebAssembly [ 56 , 28 ] and blockchain smart contracts [ 61 , 33 , 16 , 47 ] , since that lies outside our standard and embedded computer-architecture scope. The resultant 13 13 peer-reviewed in-scope methods are augmented by 5 5 arXiv pre-prints until July 2026 selected using the same methodology to create an exhaustive and diverse set of 18 18 LLM-assisted source-recovery methods included chronologically in Table I . Following the same funneling logic as above, we consider four benchmarks and empirical evaluations of LLM-assisted recovery to source code; we cover these in the next section. 2 2 2 While there are LLM-based research that focus on specific aspects of decompilation, e.g., variable names, types and function name prediction [ 73 , 72 , 70 , 55 ] , and works on compilers, IR and pseudo-C [ 80 , 7 , 19 ] , we limit the scope of our work to the specific problem of “source code recovery”.
paragraphs.zh: 本节深入探讨了当前关于大型语言模型（LLM）辅助源代码恢复的文献，并为此领域构建了一个五轴分类体系。 我们通过查询 DBLP 数据库（时间范围：2020 年 1 月至 2026 年 7 月），并使用包含“反编译”“二进制转源代码”“汇编转源代码”“字节码转源代码”“伪代码转源代码”“源代码恢复”和“恢复*源代码”等关键词（及其变体）的集合，收集了我们的文献语料库。 此次检索范围限定于 A 和 A* CORE 排名 1 1 1 https://portal.core.edu.au/conf-ranks/ 的三个领域：网络安全（S&P、USENIX Security、CCS、NDSS、EuroS&P、ASIACCS、CSF、ESORICS、RAID、ACSAC、DSN、TIFS、TDSC、WWW）、软件工程（ICSE、FSE/ISSTA、ASE、SANER、ICSME、ISSRE、MSR、ICPC、ESEM、TSE、TOSEM、EMSE）以及人工智能（NeurIPS、ICML、ICLR、AAAI、IJCAI、ACL、EMNLP、NAACL、COLING、EACL、COLM、AISTATS、UAI、TACL、JMLR、TMLR）。 我们手动补充了两篇缺失的文献：由于标题中缺乏相关关键词，我们纳入了 Nova [ 41 ]；而 SK2Decompile [ 64 ] 则因其发表时间较近而被纳入。 该方法共检索出 57 篇候选论文，其中 52 篇与反编译相关，包括 35 篇方法论文和 17 篇综述或评估论文。 在这 35 篇方法论文中，有 31 篇明确属于源代码恢复的范畴，进一步细分为 19 篇 LLM 辅助方法和 12 篇传统的（非 LLM）源代码恢复研究。 我们仅关注 LLM 辅助方法，排除六篇针对虚拟机（VM）字节码（如 WebAssembly [ 56 , 28 ]）和区块链智能合约 [ 61 , 33 , 16 , 47 ] 的研究，因为这些内容超出了我们的标准计算机架构和嵌入式系统研究范围。 最终确定的 13 篇经过同行评审且符合研究范围的方法，结合截至 2026 年 7 月通过相同方法筛选出的 5 篇 arXiv 预印论文，共同构成了一个全面且多样化的 18 种 LLM 辅助源代码恢复方法集合，并按时间顺序列于表 I。 遵循上述相同的筛选逻辑，我们考察了四项针对 LLM 辅助源代码恢复的基准测试与实证研究；相关内容将在下一节中展开。2 2 2 尽管存在一些基于 LLM 的研究聚焦于反编译的特定方面（例如变量名、类型和函数名预测 [ 73 , 72 , 70 , 55 ]），以及涉及编译器、中间表示和伪 C 语言的研究 [ 80 , 7 , 19 ]，但我们将本研究范围严格限定在“源代码恢复”这一特定问题上。

paragraphs.en: The following subsections compile the surveyed benchmark and evaluation studies, and then systematize method papers on LLM-assisted source recovery.
paragraphs.zh: 以下各小节汇总了所调研的基准测试与评估研究，随后对有关大语言模型辅助源恢复的方法论文进行了系统梳理。

paragraphs.en: We first evaluate the coverage of existing surveys and evaluations of LLM-assisted source code recovery and highlight the gap in systematization.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先评估现有关于 LLM 辅助源代码恢复的综述与评估的覆盖范围，并指出其在系统化方面的不足。

paragraphs.en: We characterize each research work through five-axes taxonomy, as depicted in Fig. 1 and Table I :
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过图 1 和表 I 所示的五维分类法来描述每一项研究工作：

paragraphs.en: Model setup (M): This axis depicts how the underlying LLM is prepared: off-the-shelf ( M 1 \text{M}_{1} ) [ 38 , 71 , 46 , 13 , 79 , 78 , 18 , 30 ] , fine-tuned from a checkpoint ( M 2 \text{M}_{2} ) [ 65 , 29 , 63 , 23 , 2 , 64 , 49 , 59 , 62 ] , or pre-trained for decompilation ( M 3 \text{M}_{3} ) [ 41 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 模型设置（M）：该轴描述了底层 LLM 的准备方式：直接使用现成模型（ M 1 \text{M}_{1} ）[ 38 , 71 , 46 , 13 , 79 , 78 , 18 , 30 ]，基于检查点进行微调（ M 2 \text{M}_{2} ）[ 65 , 29 , 63 , 23 , 2 , 64 , 49 , 59 , 62 ]，或为反编译进行预训练（ M 3 \text{M}_{3} ）[ 41 ]。

paragraphs.en: Control flow (C): This axis characterizes how the model is driven, including single-pass generation ( C 1 \text{C}_{1} ) [ 38 , 65 , 29 , 63 , 41 , 46 , 79 , 23 , 2 , 64 , 59 , 62 ] , iterative feedback-driven repair loop ( C 2 \text{C}_{2} ) [ 71 , 78 , 18 , 49 , 30 ] , or an autonomous tool-using agent ( C 3 \text{C}_{3} ) [ 13 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 控制流（C）：该维度描述了模型的驱动方式，包括单次生成（ C 1 \text{C}_{1} ）[ 38 , 65 , 29 , 63 , 41 , 46 , 79 , 23 , 2 , 64 , 59 , 62 ]、迭代反馈驱动的修复循环（ C 2 \text{C}_{2} ）[ 71 , 78 , 18 , 49 , 30 ]，或使用自主工具的智能体（ C 3 \text{C}_{3} ）[ 13 ]。

paragraphs.en: Number of roles per turn (R): This axis depicts the functional decomposition of the LLM into various roles, for example, “code generator” and “reviewer”, per decompilation pass. Types including single role ( R 1 \text{R}_{1} ) [ 65 , 29 , 71 , 41 , 63 , 23 , 2 , 13 , 49 , 59 , 30 , 62 ] , or multiple specialized roles ( R 2 \text{R}_{2} ) [ 38 , 46 , 79 , 64 , 78 , 18 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 每轮角色数量（R）：该轴描述了 LLM 在每次反编译过程中被分解为不同角色的情况，例如“代码生成器”和“审查员”。 类型包括单一角色（ R 1 \text{R}_{1} ）[ 65 , 29 , 71 , 41 , 63 , 23 , 2 , 13 , 49 , 59 , 30 , 62 ]，或多个专业化角色（ R 2 \text{R}_{2} ）[ 38 , 46 , 79 , 64 , 78 , 18 ]。

paragraphs.en: Input representation (I): This axis depicts the binary-derived forms included in the input to the LLM, covering forms such has hex, assembly, and low-level IR ( I 1 \text{I}_{1} ) [ 65 , 29 , 63 , 41 , 13 , 2 , 49 , 30 , 62 ] , classical decompiler pseudo-C ( I 2 \text{I}_{2} ) [ 38 , 65 , 71 , 46 , 79 , 23 , 64 , 78 , 18 , 49 , 59 , 30 ] ), and structural enrichment such as rodata, control-flow graphs (CFG), callees, .data, and .bss ( I 3 \text{I}_{3} ) [ 13 , 79 , 23 , 18 , 59 , 30 , 62 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 输入表示（I）：该轴描述了包含在 LLM 输入中的二进制衍生形式，涵盖十六进制、汇编语言以及低级 IR（ I 1 \text{I}_{1} ）[ 65 , 29 , 63 , 41 , 13 , 2 , 49 , 30 , 62 ] 等形式，经典反编译器伪 C 语言（ I 2 \text{I}_{2} ）[ 38 , 65 , 71 , 46 , 79 , 23 , 64 , 78 , 18 , 49 , 59 , 30 ]，以及结构增强内容，如 rodata、控制流图（CFG）、被调用函数、.data 和 .bss（ I 3 \text{I}_{3} ）[ 13 , 79 , 23 , 18 , 59 , 30 , 62 ]。

paragraphs.en: Augmentation (A): The last axis depicts the inference-time mechanism divided into context provisioning through retrieval augmented generation (RAG, A 1 \text{A}_{1} ) [ 46 , 79 , 30 ] and self-exemplar ( A 2 \text{A}_{2} ) [ 29 ] ), and verifier feedback, including compiler ( A 3 \text{A}_{3} ) [ 71 , 13 , 78 , 18 , 49 , 59 ] , execution ( A 4 \text{A}_{4} ) [ 71 , 13 , 78 , 18 , 49 ] , and semantics ( A 5 \text{A}_{5} ) [ 38 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 增强（A）：最后一个轴描述了推理时的机制，该机制分为通过检索增强生成（RAG，A 1 \text{A}_{1} ）[ 46 , 79 , 30 ] 和自示例（ A 2 \text{A}_{2} ）[ 29 ] 提供上下文，以及验证器反馈，包括编译器（ A 3 \text{A}_{3} ）[ 71 , 13 , 78 , 18 , 49 , 59 ]、执行（ A 4 \text{A}_{4} ）[ 71 , 13 , 78 , 18 , 49 ] 和语义（ A 5 \text{A}_{5} ）[ 38 ]。

paragraphs.en: Research in 2024-2025: The field of LLM-assisted source code recovery opened with single-pass methods, wherein a single forward generation produces the recovered source. DeGPT [ 38 ] prompts an off-the-shelf GPT-3.5 with Ghidra pseudo-C passed through a fixed three-role pipeline comprising a referee that decides which of structure simplification, comment insertion, or variable renaming to apply, an advisor that proposes the edits, and an operator that accepts or rejects each edit through a Micro Snippet Semantic Calculation (MSSC) gate, adding no external data beyond that semantic check. LLM4Decompile [ 65 ] fine-tunes DeepSeek-Coder into a decompiler series that translates in one pass under two input regimes, end-to-end from raw x86-64 assembly or refinement from Ghidra pseudo-C. SCCDEC [ 29 ] stays within single-pass control but adds self-augmentation: its tuning-free variant recompiles the model’s own draft into a self-constructed (assembly, source) exemplar that is prepended before a second decompilation, and a companion fine-tuned variant further aligns the model to reach its best results. Nova [ 41 ] takes the most training-heavy route, pre-training an assembly-native model from DeepSeek-Coder with hierarchical attention and contrastive objectives and decompiling stripped x86-64 assembly in a single pass. PtxDec [ 63 ] fine-tunes Qwen2.5-Coder-7B and Qwen3-32B to translate optimized GPU PTX, normalized into a compact rolled-PTX intermediate representation, back into readable CUDA. PseudoFix [ 46 ] prompts off-the-shelf models with decompiler pseudo-C in a fixed detect-then-refactor sweep across six structural-distortion types, retrieving similar examples from an external distortion database to ground each fix. The lone departure from single-pass control was DecLLM [ 71 ] , which wraps off-the-shelf GPT-3.5 and GPT-4 in an iterative repair loop that recompiles and re-runs each candidate to repair the input pseudo-C, feeding back compiler errors, ASan reports, and test- and fuzzing-detected output divergences for up to fifteen rounds, foreshadowing the direction the field would take a year later.

paragraphs.en: Research in 2026: Research in 2026 brought both a diversification of single-pass designs and a decisive shift toward iterative control. The sole fully agentic system (i.e. featuring an LLM with tool-calling capabilities), Cao [ 13 ] , deploys an off-the-shelf coding agent that autonomously reads AVR firmware disassembly and its interrupt-vector table and refines its output against avr-gcc recompilation and cycle-accurate simavr behavioral traces. Single-pass generation continued but grew richer in inputs and roles: FidelityGPT [ 79 ] runs a two-role detect-then-correct pass over pseudo-C enriched with a program-dependence graph and retrieves from an annotated distortion database. Idioms [ 23 ] fine-tunes local models to generate code and its user-defined type definitions jointly, feeding decompiler pseudo-C together with neighboring functions drawn from the call graph. Abualazm et al. [ 2 ] fine-tune reasoning models to recover idiomatic Dart from the x86-64 assembly of ahead-of-time-compiled binaries. SK2Decompile [ 64 ] splits the task across two models, each supervised-fine-tuned then reinforcement-learning-tuned, a structure-recovery phase over IDA-Pro pseudo-C followed by an identifier-naming phase. RlDecompiler [ 62 ] trains an end-to-end model with supervised fine-tuning followed by Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), whose input assembly is enriched with extracted string and floating-point constants and relabeled basic blocks. Finally, Decaf [ 59 ] forgoes a loop for best-of- N N search, sampling many decompilations of Ghidra pseudo-C with declared types and globals, discarding those that fail to compile, and selecting the best with a learned re-ranker. The defining trend, however, was a wave of iterative feedback methods: Agent4Decompile [ 78 ] drives three specialized repair LLM roles covering syntax, compilation, and execution from a scripted validator over decompiler pseudo-C. Although its name suggests an agentic control-flow, the models in this work do not exercise tool-calling agentic capability, making it an iterative, multi-role approach. PCodeTrans [ 18 ] passes Hex-Rays pseudo-C plus a recovered type-dependency graph, globals, and callees through bounded compiler, sanitizer, and breakpoint-differential repair stages. AutoDecompiler [ 49 ] fine-tunes with supervised then reinforcement learning to perform up-to-three-turn refinement of assembly- or pseudo-C-derived output against compiler, runtime, and I/O-test feedback.
paragraphs.zh: 2026年的研究：2026年的研究既带来了单遍设计的多样化，也促成了向迭代控制的决定性转变。 唯一完全具备智能体能力的系统（即配备具有工具调用能力的LLM的系统），Cao [ 13 ]，部署了一个现成的编码智能体，该智能体能自主读取AVR固件反汇编代码及其中断向量表，并通过avr-gcc重新编译和基于cycle-accurate simavr的行为追踪来优化其输出。 单遍生成方法仍在延续，但其输入和角色变得更加丰富：FidelityGPT [ 79 ] 对包含程序依赖图的伪C代码执行“先检测后修正”的双角色流程，并从带有标注的失真数据库中检索信息。 Idioms [ 23 ] 通过微调本地模型来联合生成代码及其用户自定义类型定义，输入包括反编译器生成的伪C代码以及调用图中提取的相邻函数。Abualazm等人 [ 2 ] 通过微调推理模型，从提前编译的二进制文件的x86-64汇编代码中恢复惯用的Dart代码。 SK2Decompile [ 64 ] 将任务分解为两个模型：每个模型先经过监督微调，再进行强化学习调整；流程包括对IDA-Pro伪C代码的结构恢复阶段，以及随后的标识符命名阶段。 RlDecompiler [ 62 ] 训练一个端到端模型，采用监督微调结合群体相对策略优化（GRPO）方法；其输入汇编代码经过提取字符串和浮点常数、重标记基本块的增强处理。 最后，Decaf [ 59 ] 摒弃了循环结构，转而采用“N个最佳方案”中的最优搜索策略：对Ghidra伪C代码进行多次反编译采样（包含声明的类型和全局变量），丢弃无法编译的结果，并通过一个学习到的重排序器选出最佳结果。 然而，最具代表性的趋势是迭代反馈方法的兴起：Agent4Decompile [ 78 ] 通过一个脚本化的验证器，驱动三个专门用于修复的LLM角色，分别处理反编译器生成的伪C代码的语法、编译和执行问题。 尽管其名称暗示了智能体式的控制流，但这项工作中的模型并未具备工具调用的智能体能力，因此它本质上是一种迭代的多角色方法。 PCodeTrans [ 18 ] 将Hex-Rays伪C代码与恢复的类型依赖图、全局变量和调用目标一同输入有界编译器、安全检查和断点差异修复阶段进行处理。 AutoDecompiler [ 49 ] 先通过监督学习，再结合强化学习进行微调，从而对源自汇编或伪C代码的输出执行最多三轮的优化，并依据编译器、运行时和I/O测试的反馈进行调整。

paragraphs.en: Compilation: Depicts whether the recovered code parses, compiles, and links [ 29 , 71 , 63 , 13 , 2 , 62 , 78 , 18 , 49 , 59 , 31 , 1 , 77 ] .

Readability: Depicts how easy the generated code is to read and is evaluated using complexity indices, naming and comment quality, human ratings, or LLM judges [ 38 , 65 , 46 , 79 , 64 , 62 , 49 , 31 , 66 ] .

paragraphs.en: The identified prior works measure lexical similarity using 8 8 metrics, dominated by CodeBLEU’s n-gram component [ 63 , 2 , 66 , 1 , 77 ] , and edit similarity [ 65 , 59 , 66 ] . BLEU-4 , METEOR , and ROUGE-L appear in a single paper [ 46 ] , and a LOC ratio serves as a coarse size-fidelity metric [ 13 ] . Identifier recovery is also scored at the token level against the original identifiers, by variable name accuracy [ 23 ] and the meaningful variable ratio [ 38 ] ; both are string comparisons and, unlike the meaning-level instruments below, neither is invariant to renaming. Syntactic similarity exists in this literature only as CodeBLEU’s AST-match component [ 63 , 2 , 66 , 1 , 77 ] . Semantic similarity is the broadest and least standardized axis, with 19 19 metrics across 17 17 papers. It spans metrics for static graph comparison, including dependency equivalence [ 23 ] , which tests dependency-graph isomorphism as an approximation of program equivalence, and CodeBLEU’s Data Flow (DF)-match , and recovery accuracy for variable types , user-defined types [ 23 ] , and function names [ 78 ] . Binary-level equivalence is established by the byte-wise match of recompiled functions [ 59 ] , and structure-fidelity correctness is annotated manually against the original source [ 46 ] . Learned similarity metrics include embedding cosine similarity [ 46 , 66 ] and CodeScore [ 77 ] , and downstream utility is evaluated with CodeQL vulnerability detection [ 71 , 59 ] and vulnerability pattern preservation [ 78 ] . Judged and rubric-based composites, namely those of Cao [ 13 ] and Yoda et al. [ 77 ] , the correctness half of the LLM-judge Elo criteria [ 31 , 62 ] , and the source-referencing GPT judges [ 65 , 64 , 66 ] , cut across these semantic families. Functional similarity is evaluated in 16 16 of the 22 22 papers by executing the recompiled code: 11 11 of them reporting re-executability [ 65 , 29 , 71 , 23 , 64 , 62 , 78 , 18 , 49 , 59 , 66 ] and 3 3 reporting pass@ k k [ 41 , 62 , 1 ] , while the rest test runtime behavior through trace equivalence [ 13 ] , coverage equivalence [ 31 ] , sanitizer-guided repair [ 71 , 18 ] , and fuzzing [ 71 , 78 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 已识别的前期工作使用 8 项指标衡量词汇相似性，其中 CodeBLEU 的 n-gram 成分 [63, 2, 66, 1, 77] 和编辑相似性 [65, 59, 66] 占主导地位。BLEU-4、METEOR 和 ROUGE-L 仅出现在一篇论文中 [46]，而 LOC 比率则用作粗略的大小保真度指标 [13]。标识符恢复也在词元级别上与原始标识符进行评分，具体通过变量名准确性 [23] 和有意义变量比率 [38] 来衡量；两者均为字符串比较，与下文提到的语义层面工具不同，它们对重命名均不保持不变。在此文献中，句法相似性仅体现为 CodeBLEU 的 AST 匹配成分 [63, 2, 66, 1, 77]。语义相似性是最广泛且标准化程度最低的维度，涉及 17 篇论文中的 19 项指标。它涵盖了静态图比较的指标，包括依赖等价性 [23]（通过测试依赖图的同构性来近似程序等价性）、CodeBLEU 的数据流（DF）匹配，以及变量类型、用户定义类型 [23] 和函数名的恢复准确性 [78]。二进制层面的等价性通过重新编译后的函数的字节级匹配来确立 [59]，而结构保真度的正确性则通过与原始源代码进行人工标注来确定 [46]。基于学习的相似性指标包括嵌入余弦相似度 [46, 66] 和 CodeScore [77]，其下游效用则通过 CodeQL 漏洞检测 [71, 59] 和漏洞模式保留情况 [78] 进行评估。经过判断和评分标准综合评估的指标，即 Cao [13] 和 Yoda 等人 [77] 的方法、LLM-judge Elo 标准的正确性部分 [31, 62]，以及引用源代码的 GPT 评判者 [65, 64, 66]，跨越了这些语义类别。功能相似性在 22 篇论文中的 16 篇中通过执行重新编译后的代码进行评估：其中 11 篇报告了可重执行性 [65, 29, 71, 23, 64, 62, 78, 18, 49, 59, 66]，3 篇报告了 pass@k 指标 [41, 62, 1]，其余论文则通过轨迹等价性 [13]、覆盖等价性 [31]、由 sanitizer 引导的修复 [71, 18] 和模糊测试 [71, 78] 来检验运行时行为。

paragraphs.en: Re-compilation rate (RC) and Re-execution Rate (RE) are the most prevalent compilation quality and functional similarity metrics reported in prior works. In its traditional form, R ​ C RC is the ratio of generated functions that compile (standalone) to the total number of evaluation functions. Our results (Fig. 4 and 15 ) indicate that LLMs are better at generating compilable code than recovering the correct signature. This takeaway is typically missed by RC and muddled in RE which targets functional correctness. Thus, Re-compilation Rate with caller Interface (RCI) is a valuable metric that can be computed using a benchmark’s evaluation harness. Further, RC, RCI, and RE follow a nested relationship ( R ​ E ≤ R ​ C ​ I ≤ R ​ C RE\leq RCI\leq RC ): RCI and RE are our choice for compilation quality and functional similarity metrics, respectively.

paragraphs.en: We use Edit Similarity (ES) for lexical similarity. ES measures surface fidelity by computing the normalized Levenshtein distance between two code snippets reported in the range [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] , with higher values indicating closer surface form. We use CodeBLEU’s AST-match (AST) [ 53 ] to abstract-syntax-tree structure for syntactic similarity. AST is largely insensitive to the naming noise that dominates ES and provides a more specific measure of the relative syntactical structure of the recovered source. It is also the only syntactic similarity metric used in the surveyed literature in Section III . CodeBLEU’s DF-match (DF) [ 53 ] is used for semantic similarity using source-derived DF comparison: it matches def-then-use graphs, abstracting away both naming and syntactic idiom to test whether values flow through the recovered code as they do in the original. These three metrics compare against the original source. Byte-wise match (BW) [ 59 ] instead provides semantic similarity at the binary level, recompiling the generated function with the original compiler and flags and comparing the resulting machine code byte-for-byte against the original binary (wildcarding relocation sites). BW is the strictest metric in our suite since any divergence in instruction selection fails it, even between behaviorally identical programs and a pass certifies recovery up to compiler determinism.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用编辑相似度（ES）来衡量词汇相似度。 ES 通过计算两个代码片段之间的归一化莱文斯坦距离，在 [0,1] 范围内衡量表面形式的保真度，数值越高表示表面形式越接近。 我们使用 CodeBLEU 的 AST 匹配（AST）[53] 来评估抽象语法树结构，从而衡量句法相似度。 AST 在很大程度上不受命名噪声的影响（这种噪声在 ES 中占主导地位），因此能更精确地衡量恢复出的源代码的相对句法结构。 它也是第三部分所综述文献中唯一使用的句法相似度指标。 CodeBLEU 的 DF 匹配（DF）[53] 用于语义相似度评估，其方法是通过源自源代码的 DF 进行比较：它通过匹配“定义-然后使用”图，抽象掉命名和句法习语，以检验恢复出的代码中值是否像原始代码一样流动。 这三种指标均与原始源代码进行比较。 字节级匹配（BW）[59] 则是在二进制层面上提供语义相似度：它使用原始编译器和编译标志重新编译生成的函数，并将结果机器码逐字节与原始二进制文件进行比较（对重定位位置使用通配符处理）。 BW 是我们指标套件中最严格的指标，因为任何指令选择的差异都会导致其判定失败，即使两个程序行为完全相同；而通过测试则证明恢复过程在编译器决定论的范围内是成功的。

paragraphs.en: We conduct three empirical evaluations, detailed as follows: First, “SOTA Method Evaluation” (reported in Section VI-A ) evaluates the impact of the following: (1) Design choices of SOTA methods following the taxonomy defined in Section III ; (2) Generalization of SOTA methods over four standard (x86-64, aarch64, riscv64, x86-32) and five embedded (armv7m, armv8m, armv7a, armv8a32, mips32le) architectures, five optimization levels ( O0-O3, Os ), and stripped and unstripped symbol variants; and (3) Spearman correlation of the metrics suite derived from the above. We select LLM4Decompile (assembly and Ghidra) [ 65 ] , SCCDEC [ 29 ] , Nova [ 41 ] , SK2Decompile [ 64 ] , DeGPT [ 38 ] , FidelityGPT [ 79 ] , and Agent4Decompile [ 78 ] for evaluations, encompassing majority of the identified methodology axes ( M , C , R , I , A \text{M},\text{C},\text{R},\text{I},\text{A} ) and their subcategories, subject to code availability. Only C 3 \text{C}_{3} (agentic control-flow) has no representative method in our evaluation since Cao [ 13 ] , which is the only identified agentic approach, has not published its code. We note again that Agent4Decompile [ 78 ] is classified as an iterative method. Methods that fine-tune or pre-train their own models are evaluated using their specified models, while methods that use off-the-shelf models are evaluated using HuggingFace sourced gemma4-31b-it [ 68 ] for comparison at the same intelligence capability.
paragraphs.zh: 我们进行了三项实证评估，具体如下：首先，“SOTA 方法评估”（见第六节 A 部分）评估了以下因素的影响：(1) 遵循第三部分所定义分类法的 SOTA 方法的设计选择；(2) SOTA 方法在四种标准架构（x86-64、aarch64、riscv64、x86-32）和五种嵌入式架构（armv7m、armv8m、armv7a、armv8a32、mips32le）、五个优化级别（O0-O3、Os），以及剥离符号与未剥离符号变体上的泛化能力；以及 (3) 基于上述内容推导出的指标集之间的斯皮尔曼相关性。 我们选择了 LLM4Decompile（汇编和 Ghidra）[65]、SCCDEC [29]、Nova [41]、SK2Decompile [64]、DeGPT [38]、FidelityGPT [79] 和 Agent4Decompile [78] 进行评估，这些方法涵盖了已识别的方法论维度（M、C、R、I、A）及其子类别中的大部分，前提是代码可用。 在我们的评估中，只有 C₃（智能体控制流）没有代表性方法，因为 Cao [13]——唯一已识别的智能体方法——尚未发布其代码。 我们再次指出，Agent4Decompile [78] 被归类为迭代方法。 对自身模型进行微调或预训练的方法使用其指定的模型进行评估，而使用现成模型的方法则使用 HuggingFace 提供的 gemma4-31b-it [68] 进行评估，以便在相同智能能力水平上进行比较。

paragraphs.en: Second, “Taxonomy-driven Pipeline Ablation” (reported in Section VI-B ) ablates five aspects of the source recovery pipeline: (1) Base input representation (hex, assembly, IR, pseudo-C) provided to a single-role, single-pass pipeline (SP), and subsequently; (2) Enrichment channels (callee imports, .rodata, .data/.bss, CFG, and frame ABI) that aid SP with additional context; (3) LLMs of different scale in the SP pipeline; (4) Iterative control-flow with one compiler diagnostic feedback iteration (CIT); and (5) Review-role (RR) pipeline using a reviewer LLM to improve the code based on static analysis. Each pipeline uses open-weight LLMs from HuggingFace: gemma4-12b-it [ 68 ] , gemma4-31b-it [ 68 ] and qwen3.8-27b [ 52 ] at bf16 quantization, 0.1 temperature, and a 8192-token generation limit and within a 32768-token context. For reference, a CIT or RR pipeline with a 31b LLM is represented as “CIT-31b” or “RR-31b”, respectively. Ablations are conducted on 50 C-code compiled on x86-64 at two optimizations (O0 and O2).
paragraphs.zh: 其次，“基于分类学的管道消融”（见第六节 B 部分）对源恢复管道的五个方面进行了消融：(1) 提供给单角色、单通管道（SP）的基础输入表示形式（十六进制、汇编语言、IR、伪 C），以及后续步骤；(2) 为 SP 提供额外上下文的增强通道（被调用函数导入项、.rodata、.data/.bss、CFG 和帧 ABI）；(3) SP 管道中不同规模的 LLM；(4) 包含一次编译器诊断反馈迭代（CIT）的迭代控制流；以及 (5) 使用评审者 LLM 基于静态分析改进代码的评审角色（RR）管道。 每个管道均使用来自 HuggingFace 的开放权重 LLM：gemma4-12b-it [68]、gemma4-31b-it [68] 和 qwen3.8-27b [52]，采用 bf16 量化、0.1 的温度值、8192 个标记的生成限制，并在 32768 个标记的上下文中运行。 作为参考，使用 31b LLM 的 CIT 或 RR 管道分别表示为“CIT-31b”或“RR-31b”。 消融实验在 x86-64 架构上以两种优化级别（O0 和 O2）编译的 50 个 C 语言代码上进行。

paragraphs.en: We first present our observations of SOTA methods linked to the taxonomy described in Fig. 1 and Table I . As depicted in Fig. 3 , methods that ingest pseudo-C (DeGPT, LLM4Decompile-Ghidra, FidelityGPT, SK2Decompile, and Agent4Decompile) outperform those that use assembly across all metrics, architectures, optimizations, and symbol variants, regardless of other harness differences: averaged over their tiers, pseudo-C methods reach RCI 0.47, Δ R2I \Delta_{\text{R2I}} 0.24, ES 0.36, AST 0.40, DF 0.53, BW 0.17, and RE 0.36, against assembly-based methods. Further, methods that use off-the-shelf, general-purpose models (Agent4Decompile, FidelityGPT, DeGPT) achieve fidelity comparable to counterparts fine-tuned on pseudo-C (SK2Decompile, LLM4Decompile-Ghidra), and significantly better than those fine-tuned or pre-trained on source recovery from assembly (SCCDEC, LLM4Decompile-ASM, Nova). Interestingly, SK2Decompile is among the top half of methods when tested using Ghidra pseudo-C despite its IDA Pro pseudo-C fine-tuning.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先介绍了对 SOTA 方法的观察结果，这些方法与图 1 和表 I 中描述的分类体系相关。 如图 3 所示，在所有指标、架构、优化和符号变体中，使用伪 C 语言（DeGPT、LLM4Decompile-Ghidra、FidelityGPT、SK2Decompile 和 Agent4Decompile）的方法均优于使用汇编语言的方法，无论其他测试框架有何差异：在其各自层级上平均计算后，伪 C 方法实现了 RCI 0.47、Δ R2I \Delta_{\text{R2I}} 0.24、ES 0.36、AST 0.40、DF 0.53、BW 0.17 和 RE 0.36，而基于汇编的方法则表现较差。 此外，使用现成通用模型的方法（Agent4Decompile、FidelityGPT、DeGPT）所达到的保真度可与在伪 C 语言上微调的对应方法（SK2Decompile、LLM4Decompile-Ghidra）相媲美，并且显著优于在从汇编恢复源代码上进行微调或预训练的方法（SCCDEC、LLM4Decompile-ASM、Nova）。 有趣的是，尽管 SK2Decompile 是在 IDA Pro 伪 C 语言上微调的，但在使用 Ghidra 伪 C 语言进行测试时，它仍位列方法表现的前半部分。

paragraphs.en: Examining the control flow and multi-role methods, we note that iterative multi-role methods (Agent4Decompile) report the highest RCI, BW, and RE compared to all other control flows through their targeted refinement iterations using in-loop compiler and functional feedback [ 78 ] . LLM4Decompile-GHIDRA is the best-performing single-pass and single-role method, attributed to its pseudo-C training. Lastly, multi-role methods (Agent4Decompile, FidelityGPT, DeGPT, SK2Decompile) generally outperform single-role ones (LLM4Decompile-ASM, Nova, SCCDEC).

paragraphs.en: Table VI in Appendix presents the full set of results for O0/O2 across 7 metrics derived from the three model scales. Fig. 9(a) depicts the ablation of hex, asm, Ghidra p-code and Ghidra pseudo-C using the SP-31b pipeline on 100 samples covering 50 functions compiled on x86 with O0 and O2 optimizations with stripped symbols. Evidently, pseudo-C achieves the best relative performance across all metrics. gemma4-12b-it and qwen3.8-27b show the same relative pattern, as seen in Table VI (Appendix). Further, Fig. 9(b) presents the impact of various enrichment channels, including callee imports, .rodata, .data/.bss, CFG, frame ABI and all (combined enrichment). Frame ABI and cfg are available for all samples, but show limited or negative improvement in RCI and RE, respectively. Callees and .rodata are available in 12% and 20% of the samples, respectively and show over 20% improvement. paragraphs.en: We observe 14.3%, 64%, and 37% improvement in RCI, BW, and RE when switching SP-12b to SP-31b, showing that among recent general-purpose models, bigger LLMs achieve better performance. Further, we observe improvements of 32% RCI, 5% AST, 8.7% BW, and 25.5% RE when switching SP-31b to CIT-31b, indicating the impact of targeted, high-quality functional feedback provided by the compiler diagnostics in helping the LLM fix its previous generation. However, CIT-31b incurs a degradation of 18.3% Δ R2I \Delta_{\text{R2I}} and 3.8% ES due to defensive code frames added into new generations for compilability. Moreover, 25.5% RE and 8.7% BW gains through pure compiler feedback highlights the functional and semantic similarity hidden behind compilation errors. paragraphs.en: Fig. 11 presents the RCI and RE of same- and cross-language recovery using SP-31b and CIT-31b pipelines for C, C++, Go, Rust, Fortran, and Ada. Same-language recovery exposes a performance gap when viewed through the metrics of compilability and functional similarity. With the exception of Ada (16% RCI), non-C languages recompile at rates comparable to or better than C (C++ 94%, Fortran 85%, Rust 68%), yet their RE collapses to 1-13% compared to 47% for C. A single compiler iteration widens this split: CIT-31b drives RCI up to 94–100% C++, Go, Rust, and Fortran (94-100%) while RE improves from 7% 16% for Go and only by 1% for Rust. The failure-stage decomposition in Fig. 12(a) shows that 80–88% of C++ and Rust cases compile but cannot be called by the evaluation harness due to incorrect signatures. Fortran instead runs and diverges (82% I/O divergence) and Ada does not benefit from compilation repair.

paragraphs.en: Cross-language cases present an interesting observation. Single-pass RCI is far lower (4–36%) because the model must strip the source language’s runtime scaffolding from the pseudo-C. That being the case, successful compilations overwhelmingly pass the I/O tests. Further, iteration repairs leads to nearly 2 × \times functional gains for Fortran (17% → \to 29%), C++ (14% → \to 27%), and Ada (8% → \to 13%). Go and Rust see poor performance since their binaries embed goroutine scheduling, bounds-check panics, and garbage-collection machinery that the LLM is unable to translate into plain C. Fig. 12(b) shows that recovering a non-C binary into C beats recovering it into its own source language for four of the five languages (Fortran 29% vs. 11%, C++ 27% vs. 12%, Ada 13% vs. 1%, Rust 10% vs. 1%). Finally, all cases remain below the C → \to C ceiling (59% RE with iteration). To empirically validate the hypothesis that a performance drop occurs due to C-centric lifting by Ghidra, we evaluate the cross-language CIT-31b pipelines to ingest asm . Evidently, as seen in Fig. 10 and 12(b) , pseudo-C adds 10.4% RCI and 63.9% RE for recovery of C source from C-derived assembly, but loses 8.4% RCI and gains only 16.2% RE for non-C languages. However, the improvement in cross-language RE for non-C to C over asm is still a motivation to use classical decompiler pseudo-C for source recovery. The full results of evaluations for O0/O2 across 7 metrics derived from gemma4-31b-it and qwen3.8-27b are presented in Table VIII in the Appendix.

sents.zh: 这一观察结果凸显了我们多维度评估的必要性。

paragraphs.en: Signature recovery failure (RQ1-4): Comparison of RC vs RCI across our evaluations shows that while the SOTA (and recent LLMs in general) are highly capable at generating compilable code, they fail more often in generating the correct signature, which can be mitigated with harness-aware compiler feedback iterations.
paragraphs.zh: 签名恢复失败（RQ1-4）：在我们的一系列评估中，对 RC 与 RCI 的比较表明，尽管 SOTA（以及近期的 LLM 模型总体而言）在生成可编译代码方面能力很强，但在生成正确签名时却更常出现失败；而通过引入对测试框架敏感的编译器反馈迭代，可以缓解这一问题。

paragraphs.en: Pseudo-C as a cross-architecture portability layer (RQ3): Across the architectures, methods that ingest pseudo-C showcase higher fidelity compared to those that ingest assembly. Apparently, the uniformity of Ghidra’s output absorbs the architectural shift that x86-64-assembly-trained models are sensitive to.
paragraphs.zh: 伪 C 语言作为跨架构可移植性层（RQ3）：在不同架构中，处理伪 C 语言的方法比处理汇编语言的方法展现出更高的保真度。 显然，Ghidra 输出的统一性吸收了 x86-64 汇编语言训练模型所敏感的架构变化。

sents.en: Pseudo-C as a cross-architecture portability layer (RQ3): Across the architectures, methods that ingest pseudo-C showcase higher fidelity compared to those that ingest assembly.

sents.zh: 显然，Ghidra 输出的统一性吸收了 x86-64 汇编语言训练模型所敏感的架构变化。

paragraphs.en: Performance drops for Thumb2 ISA (RQ2): Even the best performing methods show worse performance on Thumb2 architectures such as armv7-m and armv8-m, compared to standard and non-Thumb2 embedded architectures. Since Thumb2 dominates deployed IoT firmware [ 67 ] where source recovery is an important aspect of maintenance and upgrade of legacy firmware and vulnerability detection [ 42 ] , the fidelity of LLM-assisted methods in embedded systems is an open direction.
paragraphs.zh: Thumb2 ISA（RQ2）的性能有所下降：与标准和非Thumb2嵌入式架构相比，即使在性能最佳的方法中，Thumb2架构（如armv7-m和armv8-m）的表现也较差。 由于Thumb2在已部署的物联网固件中占据主导地位[67]，而源代码恢复是旧版固件维护和升级以及漏洞检测的重要环节[42]，因此LLM辅助方法在嵌入式系统中的保真度仍是一个有待探索的方向。

paragraphs.en: Drop with optimization (RQ2): RE declines monotonically from O0-O3 , and remains comparable for Os and O2 since they share the same core functionality except code alignment and size-padding optimization [ 31 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 优化后的丢弃（RQ2）：RE 从 O0 到 O3 单调下降，而 Os 和 O2 之间则保持相当，因为它们除了代码对齐和大小填充优化外，共享相同的核心功能 [31]。

paragraphs.en: Off-the-shelf models and scale (RQ3): Larger LLMs achieve higher overall fidelity, and methods that use general-purpose, off-the-shelf LLMs match the performance of those fine-tuned on pseudo-C. As a future work, clear benefits of fine-tuned models may arise for non-C.
paragraphs.zh: 现成模型与规模（研究问题3）：更大的大型语言模型能实现更高的整体保真度，而使用通用型现成大型语言模型的方法，其性能可与在伪C上微调的模型相媲美。 作为未来的工作，对于非C任务而言，微调模型可能展现出明确的优势。

Multiple roles improve readability and lexical similarity, with marginal differences in compilability, semantic, and functional similarity.
paragraphs.zh: 控制流与多角色优势（研究问题3）：迭代处理相较于单次处理提升了 RCI、BW 和 RE，但为修复编译错误而引入的框架结构却降低了可读性。 多角色提升了可读性和词汇相似度，但在可编译性、语义相似度和功能相似度方面差异不大。

paragraphs.en: Predominance of C (RQ4): The fidelity of source recovery is worse on non-C-derived binaries. Cross-recovery to C, however, is better than recovering the original source. Ghidra pseudo-C offers limited gain over assembly compared to same-language recovery to C. These observations point towards cross-language decompilers, training and augmentation as open directions.
paragraphs.zh: C 的主导性（RQ4）：对于非 C 派生的二进制文件，源代码恢复的保真度更差。 然而，跨语言恢复为 C 的效果优于恢复原始源代码。 与同语言恢复为 C 相比，Ghidra 伪 C 在相对于汇编语言方面提供的增益有限。 这些观察结果表明，跨语言反编译器、训练和增强是未来的开放方向。

sents.zh: 然而，跨语言恢复为 C 的效果优于恢复原始源代码。

paragraphs.en: ExeBench is a public benchmark and predates the training cutoffs of every model used in our work, and may be present in their pre-training dataset [ 27 ] . However, our focus is on the comparative performance between methods. We also note that recovery quality is sensitive to prompt wording, input formatting, and decoding settings [ 27 ] . SOTA methods are compared using their specified prompts, while ablations fix one prompt per task. We did not search over paraphrases, and different phrasings would likely move absolute scores. That being said, we publish all prompts along with source code. Lastly, we assume the availability and derivability of the function call interface due to the general availability of repository-level context in codebases. However, compiler interactions under the assumption of no repository-level context will show limited improvement in RCI.
paragraphs.zh: ExeBench 是一个公开基准，其出现时间早于我们工作中所用所有模型的训练截止时间，因此可能包含在它们的预训练数据集中 [ 27 ] 。 然而，我们的重点是不同方法之间的性能比较。 我们还注意到，恢复质量对提示措辞、输入格式和解码设置较为敏感 [ 27 ] 。 SOTA 方法使用其指定的提示进行比较，而消融研究则针对每个任务固定一个提示。 我们没有尝试不同的改写版本，不同的表达方式很可能会改变绝对得分。 尽管如此，我们还是公布了所有提示以及源代码。 最后，由于代码库中通常提供仓库级别的上下文信息，我们假设函数调用接口是可用的且可以推导出来的。 然而，在没有仓库级别上下文信息的假设下，与编译器的交互在 RCI 方面的提升将非常有限。

paragraphs.en: This work presented the first SoK dedicated to LLM-assisted source code recovery. We created a novel design taxonomy and organized the published methods along five axes. We also consolidated the fragmented metric landscape in this topic into six key dimensions for a holistic evaluation. We evaluated representative SOTA methods on 45,000 samples built from 500 functions, 9 standard and embedded architectures, 5 optimization levels, and 2 symbol variants. Further, we ran a controlled, taxonomy-driven ablation of input representation, contextual enrichment, model scale, iterative feedback, and review roles, deriving key insights on impactful design choices. We also measured same- and cross-language (to C) recovery across mature and legacy source languages. Open problems for future work include the general fidelity, signature failures, and coverage of non-C and Thumb2-ISA.
paragraphs.zh: 这项工作提出了首个专门针对大型语言模型辅助源代码恢复的系统性知识综述。 我们创建了一种新颖的设计分类体系，并沿着五个维度对已发表的方法进行了组织。 我们还将该领域零散的指标体系整合为六个关键维度，以实现全面的评估。 我们在由 500 个函数、9 种标准和嵌入式架构、5 种优化级别以及 2 种符号变体构建的 45,000 个样本上，对代表性的 SOTA 方法进行了评估。 此外，我们对输入表示、上下文增强、模型规模、迭代反馈和审查角色进行了受控且基于分类体系的消融研究，从而获得了关于关键设计选择的重要见解。 我们还测量了成熟和遗留源代码语言之间的同语言和跨语言（至 C 语言）恢复能力。 未来工作的开放问题包括通用保真度、签名失效以及非 C 语言和 Thumb2-ISA 的覆盖范围。

paragraphs.en: We make the following considerations: (1) While source recovery aids malware analysis, firmware vulnerability assessment, and legacy maintenance, it may also be used for IP theft and license circumvention. Our work measures and bounds the limitations of source recovery, and proposes no new method for the same. However, our evaluation harness may be used by people with malicious intent, and therefore, we urge readers to use our code ethically. (2) All our evaluations were conducted using permissively licensed C (Exebench). (3) All SOTA method evaluations were conducted using their original publicly sourced code from their respective authors. All deviations have been documented in the Appendix and our results were conducted on a unified evaluation set to ensure fair comparison.
paragraphs.zh: 我们基于以下考量：(1) 虽然源代码恢复有助于恶意软件分析、固件漏洞评估和遗留系统维护，但它也可能被用于窃取知识产权和规避许可限制。 我们的工作衡量并界定了源代码恢复的局限性，并未提出任何新的方法。 然而，我们的评估框架可能被心怀恶意的人所利用，因此我们敦促读者以合乎道德的方式使用我们的代码。 (2) 我们所有的评估均使用采用宽松许可协议的 C 语言（Exebench）进行。 (3) 所有 SOTA 方法的评估均使用其各自作者提供的原始公开源代码进行。 所有偏离之处均已记录在附录中，且我们的结果均在统一的评估集上执行，以确保比较的公平性。

paragraphs.en: LLMs were used for editorial purposes in this manuscript, and all outputs were inspected by the authors to ensure accuracy and originality. We used Anthropic’s Claude Opus-5 and Fable-5.1, to assist with writing the code. The cross-language translations were done using Claude Fable-5.1, validated against the I/O test of the original C function for functional symmetry, and spot checked by the authors. All numerical results and figures were produced by our own pipeline, generated directly from the raw experimental outputs and checked against the underlying data. The authors have reviewed all AI-assisted code, and take full responsibility for the accuracy, originality, and integrity of this work. Further, LLMs play an integral role in our experiments since they are the focus of our evaluations and thus unavoidable to use. However, we carefully considered the extent of experiments required to support our claims: the SOTA evaluations study used a larger evaluation set for fair comparison across published methods; downstream ablations (RQ3/4) used only a subset (50 functions per language on one architecture and two optimizations) to derive their findings. Thus, our LLM usage has been under the overarching consideration of accountability, correctness, transparency, and responsibility.

sents.zh: 然而，我们仔细考虑了支持研究主张所需的实验范围：SOTA 评估研究使用了更大的评估集，以便对已发表的方法进行公平比较；而下游消融分析（RQ3/4）仅使用了部分数据（每种语言在每个架构和两种优化方案下各 50 个函数）来得出结论。

sents.en: Thus, our LLM usage has been under the overarching consideration of accountability, correctness, transparency, and responsibility.
sents.zh: 因此，我们在运用大型语言模型时，始终遵循问责制、正确性、透明度和责任性的总体原则。

paragraphs.en: We provide the complete evaluation harness, including cross-compilation across nine architectures and five optimization levels, disassembly, Ghidra lifting, integrations for the eight evaluated recovery methods, and implementations of the seven evaluation metrics. Upstream methods are used verbatim with provenance, licenses, and with minimal changes to fit our study. The study runners (scripts/inputrepr/, scripts/langstudy/, scripts/control_flow/), the corpus sampler (halstead_complexity/), the Docker stack (docker_setup/), and the test suite are also provided. We provide one entry-point script per research question to run the models and reproduce the corresponding results: run_rq2.sh, run_rq3.sh, run_rq4.sh. GPU resources are required to run the scripts as it serves the models used in the study. The inputs for RQ1 are obtained from the results of RQ2.

paragraphs.en: For RQ1 and RQ2, we use the 500 functions sampled dataset. The same functions are used for both research questions. For each method, we compile these functions into 45,000 binary samples using fixed toolchain versions to ensure reproducibility. For RQ3 and RQ4, we use a shared set of 50 functions derived from the samples 500, together with a 300-function multilingual dataset created by translating each of the 50 C functions into C++, Go, Rust, Fortran, and Ada using Claude Fable-5.1. The language translation process follows the specifications defined in scripts/langstudy/contracts/. Re-execution is evaluated using the input/output test suites generated using Exebench’s testcase generation tool, located at decompbench/eval/generated_io.
paragraphs.zh: 对于研究问题 1（RQ1）和研究问题 2（RQ2），我们使用从 500 个函数中采样得到的数据集。 这两个研究问题均使用相同的函数集。 对于每种方法，我们使用固定版本的工具链将这些函数编译成 45,000 个二进制样本，以确保结果可重复。 对于研究问题 3（RQ3）和研究问题 4（RQ4），我们使用一个共享的 50 个函数集合，该集合源自上述 500 个函数的样本集；此外，我们还通过用 Claude Fable-5.1 将 50 个 C 语言函数分别翻译成 C++、Go、Rust、Fortran 和 Ada，构建了一个包含 300 个函数的多语言数据集。 语言翻译过程遵循 scripts/langstudy/contracts/ 目录中定义的规范。 重新执行评估使用 Exebench 的测试用例生成工具生成的输入/输出测试套件进行，该工具位于 decompbench/eval/generated_io 目录下。

paragraphs.en: This appendix comprises the supplementary figures and tables for our readers’ reference. Fig. 13 and 14 depict the distribution of Halstead difficulty in the dataset and method-wise performance across difficulty bins, respectively. Fig. 15 and 16 depict the nested relationship between RC, RCI, and RE across base input representation and cross-language recovery ablations. Tables III , IV , and V contain the exhaustive results for SOTA methods across architectures, optimizations, and symbol variants. Tables VI and VII present the fine-grained results for the taxonomy-driven pipeline ablations. Lastly, Table VIII presents the results for same- and cross-language recovery.
paragraphs.zh: 本附录包含补充图表，供读者参考。 图 13 和图 14 分别展示了 Halstead 难度在数据集上的分布情况，以及各方法在不同难度区间内的性能表现。 图 15 和图 16 展示了 RC、RCI 与 RE 在基础输入表示及跨语言恢复消融实验中的嵌套关系。 表 III、IV 和 V 包含了 SOTA 方法在不同架构、优化策略和符号变体下的完整结果。 表 VI 和 VII 呈现了分类驱动流程消融实验的详细结果。 最后，表 VIII 展示了同语言与跨语言恢复的结果。
